etapas.defesa: The respondent submits a defence, documents and witnesses
etapas.despacho-inicial: The inspector orders the respondent to be notified, may suspend the challenged act, or rejects the complaint
etapas.improcedente: The complaint is rejected on the merits
etapas.instrucao: The inspector hears the witnesses, carries out inquiries, sets a deadline for final arguments and writes a report
etapas.julgamento: The court rules, after hearing the Public Prosecution Service; if the complaint is upheld, it declares ineligibility and cancels the registration or certificate of election
etapas.procedente: Ineligibility for eight years, cancellation of the beneficiary's registration or certificate of election, and referral to the Public Prosecution Service
etapas.rejeitada: The complaint is dismissed outright because it is not a proper case for a complaint or a requirement is missing
etapas.representacao: A party, coalition, candidate or the Electoral Public Prosecution Service files a complaint with the electoral inspector and asks for an investigation

proc:acao-de-investigacao-judicial-eleit.resumo: Procedure under LC 64/1990 to investigate abuse of power and misuse of the media in elections: complaint to the electoral inspector, fact-finding and judgment by the court.

etapas.alegacoes-finais: The prosecution and then the defence submit written arguments
etapas.arquivamento: The rapporteur closes the inquiry at the MP's request, or refers the request to the court
etapas.condenacao: The defendant is convicted; once the decision is final, his or her political rights are suspended for as long as its effects last
etapas.denuncia: Once it receives the police inquiry, the Public Prosecution Service files an indictment or asks for the case to be closed
etapas.instrucao: The rapporteur leads the fact-finding: questioning of the defendant, preliminary defence, witnesses and inquiries
etapas.julgamento: The court rules on the action, after one hour of oral argument for the prosecution and another for the defence
etapas.notificacao-do-acusado: The rapporteur notifies the defendant, who replies in writing before the court decides on the indictment
etapas.recebimento: The court decides whether to accept or reject the indictment, or whether the charge is already unfounded
etapas.rejeicao: The indictment is rejected or the charge is found unfounded, and there is no trial

proc:acao-penal-originaria.nome: Original criminal action in the STF and the STJ
proc:acao-penal-originaria.resumo: How the STF and the STJ try authorities with special jurisdiction for ordinary crimes: indictment by the PGR, the defendant's reply, acceptance by the court, fact-finding led by the rapporteur, and judgment.

etapas.admissibilidade: The rapporteur examines the petition and dismisses it if it is defective, unfounded or manifestly without merit
etapas.indeferimento: The initial petition is dismissed and the action ends, unless an interlocutory appeal is upheld
etapas.julgamento: The Full Court rules, with at least 8 Justices present; declaring the rule constitutional or not requires 6 votes
etapas.medida-cautelar: By absolute majority, the STF may order judges and courts to suspend cases that apply the rule
etapas.modulacao: By two-thirds, the STF may restrict the effects of the unconstitutionality or set when it takes effect
etapas.pgr: The PGR gives an opinion on the constitutionality of the rule
etapas.propositura: One of the authorised parties files the action, showing that there is a significant judicial dispute over the federal rule
etapas.publicacao: The STF notifies the decision to the authority that issued the rule and publishes the operative part; it applies to everyone
etapas.relatorio: The rapporteur writes the report, sends a copy to the Justices and asks for a hearing date

proc:adc.resumo: How the STF confirms that a federal law or normative act is constitutional when judges and courts disagree about it: filing, opinion of the PGR and judgment by six votes.

etapas.admissibilidade: The rapporteur examines the petition and dismisses it if it is defective, unfounded or manifestly without merit
etapas.agu-e-pgr: The Attorney General of the Union defends the rule and then the PGR gives an opinion
etapas.indeferimento: The initial petition is dismissed and the action ends, unless an interlocutory appeal is upheld
etapas.informacoes: The rapporteur requests information from the bodies or authorities that issued the rule
etapas.julgamento: The Full Court rules, with at least 8 Justices present; declaring the rule constitutional or not requires 6 votes
etapas.medida-cautelar: The Full Court decides the request for an injunction by absolute majority, after hearing within 5 days the authority that issued the rule
etapas.modulacao: By two-thirds, the STF may restrict the effects of the declaration or set when it takes effect
etapas.propositura: One of the authorised parties files the action with the STF, identifying the challenged rule and the grounds
etapas.publicacao: The STF notifies the decision to the authority that issued the rule and publishes the operative part; it applies to everyone
etapas.relatorio: The rapporteur writes the report, sends a copy to the Justices and asks for a hearing date

proc:adi.resumo: How the STF decides whether a federal or state law or normative act breaches the Constitution: filing, information, AGU and PGR, judgment by six votes and effect for everyone.

etapas.admissibilidade: The rapporteur examines the petition and dismisses it if it is defective, unfounded or manifestly without merit
etapas.agu-e-pgr: The AGU makes a submission if the rapporteur asks, and the PGR gives an opinion when not the plaintiff
etapas.ciencia-ao-poder-competente: The STF notifies the competent Branch; if the omission is by an administrative body, it has 30 days to act
etapas.improcedencia: The action is dismissed and there is no omission to remedy
etapas.indeferimento: The initial petition is dismissed and the action ends, unless an interlocutory appeal is upheld
etapas.informacoes: The rapporteur requests information from those responsible for the omission; the other authorised parties may make submissions
etapas.julgamento: The Full Court rules, with at least 8 Justices present; declaring the omission requires 6 votes
etapas.medida-cautelar: In cases of exceptional urgency, the Full Court may grant an injunction by absolute majority, after hearing those responsible for the omission
etapas.propositura: One of the authorised parties files the action, pointing out the total or partial failure to legislate or act
etapas.relatorio: The rapporteur writes the report, sends a copy to the Justices and asks for a hearing date

proc:ado.nome: Direct action of unconstitutionality by omission (ADO)
proc:ado.resumo: How the STF rules on the lack of a law or measure that the Constitution requires: filing, information from the defaulting authority, opinion of the PGR and notice to the competent Branch.

etapas.admissibilidade: The rapporteur dismisses the petition if it is not a case for an ADPF, a requirement is missing, it is defective or another effective remedy exists
etapas.cumprimento: The President of the STF orders the decision to be carried out immediately; it applies to everyone and binds the public authorities
etapas.indeferimento: The initial petition is dismissed and the claim ends, unless an interlocutory appeal is upheld
etapas.informacoes: The rapporteur requests information from the authorities responsible for the challenged act
etapas.julgamento: The Full Court rules on the claim, with at least two-thirds of the Justices present
etapas.liminar: The Full Court decides the preliminary injunction by absolute majority; in urgent cases or during recess, the rapporteur grants it alone
etapas.modulacao: By two-thirds, the STF may restrict the effects of the unconstitutionality or set when it takes effect
etapas.pgr: The Public Prosecution Service reviews the case file, if it is not the plaintiff
etapas.propositura: One of the parties authorised to file an ADI brings the claim, identifying the fundamental precept breached and the challenged act
etapas.relatorio: The rapporteur writes the report, sends a copy to the Justices and asks for a hearing date
etapas.representacao-ao-pgr: Anyone not authorised to file may ask the PGR, by petition, to bring the claim

proc:adpf.nome: Claim of non-compliance with a fundamental precept (ADPF)
proc:adpf.resumo: How the STF rules on an act of the public authorities that breaches a fundamental precept of the Constitution when there is no other effective remedy: filing, preliminary injunction, information and judgment.

etapas.convocacao: The National Congress approves or rejects the legislative decree calling the plebiscite
etapas.lei-complementar: Congress votes on the complementary law by absolute majority, and the President assents to or vetoes it
etapas.nao-aprovado: The territorial change does not happen
etapas.novos-limites: The states take on the new boundaries, or the new state or territory comes into being, under the complementary law
etapas.plebiscito: The Electoral Justice holds the plebiscite, on the same date and at the same time in each state involved
etapas.projeto-e-audiencia: The complementary bill is introduced in one of the Houses, which hears the Legislative Assemblies of the states involved
etapas.proposta-de-plebiscito: At least one-third of the members of the Chamber or the Senate propose the legislative decree calling the plebiscite

proc:alteracao-territorial-de-estados.nome: Merger, subdivision and dismemberment of states
proc:alteracao-territorial-de-estados.resumo: Changing the map of the states, or creating a new state or territory, requires a plebiscite of the population concerned and a complementary law of Congress, after hearing the Legislative Assemblies.

etapas.convocacao-do-plebiscito: Once the EVM is published, the Assembly votes on the legislative decree calling the plebiscite
etapas.iniciativa: The State Legislative Assembly opens the procedure and arranges the Municipal Feasibility Study (EVM)
etapas.lei-estadual: The Assembly passes, and the state publishes, the state law setting the new boundaries
etapas.novos-limites: The municipalities take on the new boundaries set in the state law
etapas.plebiscito: The TRE organises a single plebiscite with the voters of the two municipalities involved
etapas.sem-lei-complementar: It cannot be done in 2026: the federal complementary law setting the period for it does not exist
etapas.tipo-de-alteracao: What change is sought: creating, merging or incorporating municipalities, or detaching part of one to join it to another?

proc:alteracao-territorial-de-municipios.nome: Creation, incorporation, merger and dismemberment of municipalities
proc:alteracao-territorial-de-municipios.resumo: Changing the map of the municipalities requires a state law, a feasibility study and a plebiscite. In 2026 there are rules only for detaching part of one municipality and joining it to another.

etapas.aplicacao: The index applies to the instalments transferred from 1 January of the following year
etapas.apuracao: The state calculates the value added in each municipality and its ratio to the state total
etapas.impugnacao: Mayors and associations of municipalities may challenge the published data and indices
etapas.julgamento: The state rules on the challenges and publishes each municipality's final indices
etapas.publicacao: The state publishes each municipality's value added and indices in the official gazette

proc:apuracao-do-indice-de-participacao-.nome: Calculation of the municipal share index of ICMS
proc:apuracao-do-indice-de-participacao-.resumo: The state calculates each municipality's value added, publishes the indices by 30 June, municipalities may challenge them, and the state rules and publishes the final indices.

etapas.analise-de-impacto: The agency carries out a regulatory impact analysis (AIR) of the proposed normative act
etapas.arquivamento: The proposal does not go ahead
etapas.audiencia-publica: The agency holds a public hearing, open to oral submissions
etapas.audiencia-publica-decisao: The board decides whether to call a public hearing on the matter
etapas.consulta-publica: The agency opens a public consultation on the draft, with notice in the Official Gazette and on its website
etapas.deliberacao: The collegiate board deliberates on the act in a public, recorded meeting
etapas.divulgacao-das-contribuicoes: The agency publishes the criticisms and suggestions received
etapas.manifestacao-da-diretoria: The collegiate board gives its view on the AIR report and decides whether the proposal goes ahead
etapas.posicionamento-sobre-contribuicoes: The agency publishes its position on the contributions to the public consultation

proc:ato-normativo-de-agencia-reguladora.nome: Issuing a normative act by a regulatory agency
proc:ato-normativo-de-agencia-reguladora.resumo: How a federal regulatory agency adopts a rule of general interest: impact analysis, public consultation of at least 45 days and a collegiate decision in a public meeting.

etapas.apreciacao: Congress reviews the documents by legislative decree, based on a report by the CCAI
etapas.aprovacao: The President approves the Policy, the Strategy and the White Paper by decree
etapas.elaboracao: The Ministry of Defence coordinates the update of the documents and implements the White Paper
etapas.encaminhamento: The Executive sends the updated Policy, Strategy and White Paper to Congress
etapas.vigencia: The documents guide federal planning and the Defence budget until the next update

proc:atualizacao-dos-documentos-de-defes.nome: Updating the National Defence Policy and Strategy and the White Paper
proc:atualizacao-dos-documentos-de-defes.resumo: Every four years the Executive updates the defence documents and sends them to Congress, which reviews them by legislative decree; in 2025 the President then approved them by decree.

etapas.adesao-dos-entes: States, DF and municipalities may apply the same restrictions to themselves
etapas.decretacao: Congress decides and, if it approves, declares the calamity, without the President's assent
etapas.fim-da-calamidade: The calamity ends, and with it the extraordinary regime
etapas.pedido: The President proposes to Congress that a nationwide public calamity be declared
etapas.regime-extraordinario: The Union adopts the extraordinary fiscal, financial and procurement regime
etapas.rejeicao: Without a decree from Congress, there is no extraordinary regime

proc:calamidade-publica-nacional.resumo: The President requests it, Congress declares it, and the Union moves to an extraordinary fiscal and procurement regime for as long as the calamity lasts.

etapas.admissao-resp-re: The president or vice-president of the court of origin decides whether to admit the special appeal and the extraordinary appeal
etapas.apelacao: The State Court of Justice or the TRF decides the appeal as a panel and issues its ruling
etapas.recurso-especial: The STJ decides the special appeal, which concerns the interpretation of federal law
etapas.recurso-extraordinario: The STF decides the extraordinary appeal, which concerns a constitutional question
etapas.sentenca: The first-instance judge decides the case and gives judgment
etapas.transito-em-julgado: The decision becomes final: no further appeal lies, and what was decided cannot be reopened

proc:caminho-de-um-processo.nome: Path of a case in the ordinary courts, from the judge to the STF
proc:caminho-de-um-processo.resumo: How a civil case moves up from the first instance (state or federal judge) to the State Court of Justice or TRF, the STJ and the STF, through an appeal, a special appeal and an extraordinary appeal.

etapas.avaliacao-das-metas-fiscais: The Minister of Finance shows the CMO that the four-monthly fiscal targets have been met and presents the debt trajectory
etapas.avaliacao-do-banco-central: The Central Bank presents to the committees of Congress its half-yearly assessment of monetary, credit and exchange-rate policies
etapas.creditos-adicionais: During the year, the budget is changed by additional appropriations voted by Congress or opened by provisional measure
etapas.entrega-dos-duodecimos: The Executive hands the Legislature, the Judiciary, the Public Prosecution Service and the Public Defender's Office the monthly twelfths of their appropriations
etapas.execucao: The government executes the budget; the CMO monitors execution
etapas.ldo-elaboracao: The Ministry of Planning and Budget drafts the LDO bill
etapas.ldo-envio: The President sends the LDO bill to Congress
etapas.ldo-sancao: The President assents to or vetoes the LDO, as with an ordinary law
etapas.ldo-tramitacao: The CMO receives amendments and gives its report; both Houses vote on the LDO
etapas.loa-elaboracao: The Executive consolidates the LOA bill with the proposals of the courts, the Public Prosecution Service and the Public Defender's Office
etapas.loa-emendas: Members of Congress, committees and state caucuses submit amendments in the CMO
etapas.loa-envio: The President sends the LOA bill (and, in the first year of the term, the PPA bill) to Congress
etapas.loa-parecer-cmo: The CMO votes on the revenue, preliminary, sectoral and general reports and sends its report to the Steering Board of Congress
etapas.loa-sancao: The President assents to or vetoes the LOA, as with an ordinary law
etapas.loa-votacao: Both Houses vote on the LOA bill and the amendments, under the joint rules
etapas.parecer-cmo-contas: The CMO examines the accounts and the TCU's opinion and proposes a draft legislative decree
etapas.parecer-previo-tcu: The TCU examines the accounts and issues a prior opinion
etapas.prestacao-de-contas: The President renders to Congress the accounts for the previous year

proc:ciclo-orcamentario.resumo: Annual path of the Union budget: the Executive proposes the LDO and the LOA, Congress amends and approves them, the government executes them and the accounts are judged.

etapas.criacao: The President of the House checks the requirements and orders the request to be published, creating the CPI
etapas.encaminhamento: The President of the House sends the report to the Public Prosecution Service or the AGU and to other competent authorities
etapas.investigacao: The CPI investigates with the powers of a judicial authority: hears witnesses, requisitions documents, carries out inquiries
etapas.pedido-devolvido: Without the requirements, the request is returned and the CPI is not created
etapas.providencias: Those who receive the report decide on the measures within their competence; only the courts can convict
etapas.relatorio: The CPI approves the report with its findings, which may propose a bill, a draft legislative decree or a draft resolution
etapas.requerimento: One-third of the deputies, the senators or both sign the request, which states a specific fact and a deadline

proc:comissao-parlamentar-de-inquerito.resumo: How a CPI is created, investigates and forwards its findings: request by 1/3 of the members, a specific fact, a fixed deadline and a report to the Public Prosecution Service.

etapas.aprovacao-e-calendario: The National Health Council approves the conference, its rules and its calendar; the Minister of Health ratifies them
etapas.etapa-estadual: State and DF conferences consolidate the proposals and elect delegates for the national stage
etapas.etapa-municipal: Municipal conferences debate the theme and its strands, approve proposals and elect delegates for the state stage
etapas.etapa-nacional: The national conference, in Brasília, approves the guidelines for formulating health policy

proc:conferencia-nacional-de-saude.resumo: Every four years, municipal, state and national conferences assess the population's health and propose guidelines for health policy. The 18th runs from 2026 to July 2027.

etapas.avaliacao: Within 30 days, the other body accepts the draft, refers the disagreement to the Harmonisation Committee, or denies that the matter is common
etapas.consulta: The taxpayer submits a written query on a specific fact to the CGIBS (IBS) or the Federal Revenue Service (CBS)
etapas.harmonizacao: The Harmonisation Committee settles the disagreement by resolution; until then, the query is suspended
etapas.ineficaz: The query is declared without effect and does not protect the applicant
etapas.minuta: The body consulted prepares a draft answer and places it in a virtual environment shared with the other
etapas.solucao: The tax ruling is issued, final and not open to appeal, binding the tax authority and the applicant on that fact

proc:consulta-sobre-a-legislacao-do-ibs-.nome: Tax ruling request on IBS and CBS legislation
proc:consulta-sobre-a-legislacao-do-ibs-.resumo: The taxpayer asks the tax authority how the law applies to his or her situation; the CGIBS and the Federal Revenue Service answer jointly on common rules, with the Harmonisation Committee settling disagreements.

etapas.alteracao-ou-extincao: The general assembly approves the amendment or termination of the contract, which requires ratification by law
etapas.alterado: The amended contract remains in force
etapas.contrato-de-consorcio: With the ratification laws, the public consortium contract is concluded and the consortium acquires legal personality
etapas.contrato-de-programa: If services are provided jointly, the obligations between entities and with the consortium go into a programme contract
etapas.contrato-de-rateio: Each member entity provides funds to the consortium through an apportionment contract, signed every financial year
etapas.estatutos: The general assembly approves the statutes, which organise the consortium's bodies
etapas.extinto: The consortium is dissolved; programme contracts continue until they end
etapas.funcionamento: The consortium operates under the oversight of the court of accounts that examines the accounts of its legal representative
etapas.protocolo-de-intencoes: The entities that will form the consortium sign the protocol of intentions and publish it in the official press
etapas.ratificacao-por-lei: Each entity's Legislature ratifies the protocol of intentions by law

proc:criacao-de-consorcio-publico.resumo: The entities sign a protocol of intentions, each Legislature ratifies it by law, and the consortium contract comes into being; funding comes through an apportionment contract.

etapas.absolvicao: If acquitted, the accused returns to office and receives the salary withheld
etapas.admissao: The Senate votes, in a single round, on whether the complaint should be considered
etapas.afastamento: From notification, the accused is suspended from office, becomes subject to criminal action and loses 1/3 of his or her salary
etapas.comissao-especial: Once received by the Steering Board, the complaint is read and sent to a special committee, which gives its view on whether it should be examined
etapas.condenacao: The convicted person loses office and is barred from public office for eight years
etapas.defesa-e-instrucao: The accused receives a copy of everything and replies; the committee gathers evidence and reports on the charge
etapas.denuncia: A citizen files a complaint with the Senate against an STF Justice or the PGR for an impeachable offence
etapas.julgamento: The Senate, presided over by the President of the STF, hears the witnesses and the parties and rules; conviction requires two-thirds
etapas.libelo-e-contrariedade: The complainant submits the bill of indictment and then the accused submits the answer, with witnesses
etapas.pronuncia: The Senate votes, in a single round, on whether the charge is well founded (indictment)

proc:crime-de-responsabilidade-de-minist.nome: Proceedings against an STF Justice or the PGR for an impeachable offence
proc:crime-de-responsabilidade-de-minist.resumo: Path of a citizen's complaint against an STF Justice or the PGR: the Senate alone admits it, indicts and tries; conviction requires two-thirds of the senators.

etapas.afastamento: The governor is suspended from office immediately
etapas.assembleia: The Assembly decides whether the complaint should be considered and then, by absolute majority, whether the charge is well founded
etapas.condenacao: The governor loses office and is barred from public office, without prejudice to proceedings in the ordinary courts
etapas.denuncia: A citizen files a complaint with the State Legislative Assembly against the governor for an impeachable offence
etapas.julgamento: The trial court rules; conviction requires two-thirds of its members
etapas.tribunal-de-julgamento: The Assembly elects five deputies and five appellate judges are drawn by lot to form the trial court

proc:crime-de-responsabilidade-do-govern.nome: Proceedings against the governor for an impeachable offence
proc:crime-de-responsabilidade-do-govern.resumo: Path of a complaint against the governor under Lei 1.079/1950: the Assembly finds the charge well founded by absolute majority and a court of deputies and appellate judges tries it.

etapas.absolvicao: If acquitted, the President is rehabilitated and returns to office, if suspended
etapas.afastamento: The President is suspended from office and the Vice-President takes over
etapas.arquivamento: The complaint is dismissed and there are no proceedings
etapas.camara-ccjc: The President of the Chamber notifies the accused and sends the request to the CCJC, which gives its report
etapas.camara-comissao-especial: A special committee, with all parties, hears the accused and reports on the authorisation
etapas.camara-plenario: The Chamber votes on the report; authorising proceedings requires two-thirds of the deputies (342 votes)
etapas.condenacao: The President loses office and is barred from public office for eight years
etapas.condenacao-crime-comum: If convicted, the President serves the penalties of criminal law and has his or her political rights suspended
etapas.denuncia: A citizen files a complaint with the Chamber against the President for an impeachable offence
etapas.denuncia-do-pgr: For an ordinary criminal offence, the PGR files an indictment against the President with the STF
etapas.julgamento: The Senate, presided over by the President of the STF, rules; conviction requires two-thirds of the senators (54 votes)
etapas.recebimento: The President of the Chamber examines the complaint and decides whether to accept it
etapas.senado-comissao-especial: The Senate reads the authorisation and elects a special committee, which reports on opening proceedings
etapas.senado-instauracao: The Senate decides, by simple majority, whether to open proceedings
etapas.senado-pronuncia: After the defence and the evidence, the Senate decides, by simple majority, whether the charge is well founded (indictment)
etapas.stf-julgamento: The STF tries the President for the ordinary criminal offence
etapas.stf-pede-autorizacao: The President of the STF asks the Chamber for authorisation to open proceedings
etapas.stf-recebe-denuncia: The STF decides whether to accept the indictment or criminal complaint

proc:crime-de-responsabilidade-do-presid.nome: Proceedings against the President of the Republic (impeachment and ordinary crime)
proc:crime-de-responsabilidade-do-presid.resumo: Path of a charge against the President: the Chamber authorises it by two-thirds; the Senate tries impeachable offences (impeachment) and the STF, ordinary crimes.

etapas.camara-comissoes: The Chamber's committees give their reports; a draft legislative decree always goes to the Plenary
etapas.camara-plenario: The Chamber Plenary votes on the draft; as a rule, it passes by a majority of votes, with an absolute majority present
etapas.iniciadora-aprecia-emendas: The originating House votes on the reviewing House's amendments, accepting or rejecting them
etapas.iniciativa: A deputy, senator or committee introduces the draft legislative decree in their House
etapas.mensagem-do-presidente: The President sends Congress the message with the act that requires approval or the request for authorisation
etapas.promulgacao: The President of the Senate promulgates the legislative decree, without assent by the President of the Republic
etapas.senado-comissoes: The Senate's committees give their reports; in some cases they decide alone (final committee decision)
etapas.senado-plenario: The Senate Plenary votes on the draft; as a rule, it passes by a majority of votes, with an absolute majority present

proc:decreto-legislativo.nome: Legislative process for a legislative decree
proc:decreto-legislativo.resumo: Path of a draft legislative decree, an act of Congress on matters within its exclusive competence: it goes through both Houses and is not sent for assent.

etapas.contestacao: States, municipalities and interested parties may contest it or claim compensation
etapas.declaracao: The Minister of Justice declares the boundaries by ministerial order, requests further inquiries or disapproves
etapas.envio: Funai sends the case to the Minister of Justice, with opinions on the challenges
etapas.estudos: Funai appoints an anthropologist and a technical group to identify and delimit the land
etapas.homologacao: The President ratifies the demarcation by decree
etapas.registro: Funai registers the land at the property registry and with the Federal Property Secretariat
etapas.relatorio: Funai approves the report and publishes a summary in the DOU and the state official gazette

proc:demarcacao-de-terra-indigena.resumo: Funai identifies and delimits the land, interested parties contest it, the Minister of Justice declares the boundaries by ministerial order and the President ratifies them by decree.

etapas.apuracao: The TCU investigates the report confidentially until it confirms that it is well founded
etapas.arquivamento: The report is closed by a reasoned order
etapas.decisao-final: The TCU decides and keeps the subject and authorship confidential only if essential to the security of society and the State
etapas.denuncia: A citizen, political party, association or trade union reports an irregularity or illegality to the TCU
etapas.procedencia: Is there evidence of irregularity or illegality?
etapas.processo-publico: The subsequent acts of the case are public, and the accused have full right of defence

proc:denuncia-ao-tcu.resumo: Any citizen, party, association or trade union may report irregularities to the TCU. The inquiry is confidential until there is evidence; the whistleblower cannot be punished, except for bad faith.

etapas.acao: Incra brings the expropriation action in the Federal Justice, with a price offer
etapas.contestacao: The owner may contest within 15 days, without disputing the social interest
etapas.decreto: The President declares the property of social interest for land reform, by decree
etapas.imissao: The federal judge puts Incra in possession of the property and summons the owner
etapas.sentenca: The judge ratifies the price agreement or sets the compensation in the judgment
etapas.transferencia: The judge issues the order transferring ownership to the expropriating party, for registration at the registry office
etapas.vistoria: Incra enters the property to gather data, with prior written notice to the owner

proc:desapropriacao-para-reforma-agraria.resumo: Incra inspects the property, the President declares the social interest by decree, Incra brings the action, and the federal judge sets the compensation and transfers the property.

etapas.avaliacao-dos-esclarecimentos: Were clarifications provided, and are they sufficient?
etapas.consulta-ao-tcu: The CMO asks the TCU for a conclusive opinion on the matter
etapas.deliberacao-do-congresso: The National Congress deliberates on the suspension
etapas.encerramento: The case does not go to the TCU
etapas.pedido-de-esclarecimentos: Faced with signs of unauthorised expenditure, the CMO asks the responsible authority for clarification
etapas.pronunciamento-do-tcu: Does the TCU consider the expenditure irregular?
etapas.proposta-de-sustacao: The CMO proposes to the National Congress that the expenditure be suspended

proc:despesa-nao-autorizada.nome: Unauthorised expenditure: request for clarification and suspension
proc:despesa-nao-autorizada.resumo: How the budget committee of Congress responds to signs of unauthorised expenditure: it asks the government for explanations, consults the TCU and may propose suspending the spending.

etapas.apuracao: Counting boards count the votes; TREs and the TSE tally them, apply the majority and proportional systems and proclaim the winners
etapas.convencoes: Parties and federations hold conventions to choose candidates and decide on coalitions for majority races
etapas.diplomacao: The Electoral Justice issues certificates of election to the winners and alternates
etapas.encerramento-do-alistamento: The voter register closes: no voter registration or transfer request is accepted in the 150 days before the election
etapas.impugnacao: Candidates, parties, federations, coalitions and the Public Prosecution Service may challenge registration requests
etapas.julgamento-dos-registros: The Electoral Justice checks eligibility and grounds for ineligibility and grants or refuses each registration
etapas.nomeacao-das-mesas: The electoral judge appoints the members of the polling boards and designates the polling places
etapas.pedido-de-registro: Parties, federations and coalitions ask the Electoral Justice to register the candidates
etapas.posse: Taking office: the President on 5 January, governors on 6 January and members of the legislatures from 1 February of the following year
etapas.prazos-seis-meses: Six months before: parties and federations registered with the TSE; candidates with residence and party membership; resignations
etapas.prestacao-de-contas: Candidates and parties render campaign accounts; the Electoral Justice judges the winners' accounts before certification
etapas.primeiro-turno: Voters across the country vote for President, governor, senator, federal deputy and state or district deputy
etapas.propaganda: Campaign: electoral advertising allowed and free airtime on radio and TV
etapas.segundo-turno: A new vote between the two leading candidates for President and, where applicable, for governor

proc:eleicao-geral.nome: General election (President, governors, senators and deputies)
proc:eleicao-geral.resumo: Every four years, on the first Sunday of October, the country elects the President, governors, senators and deputies. On 2026-10-01 the 2026 election was under way.

etapas.apuracao: Counting boards count and proclaim the results: mayor by majority; councillors by the proportional system
etapas.convencoes: Conventions choose candidates for mayor, deputy mayor and councillor and decide on coalitions for mayor
etapas.diplomacao: The electoral board issues certificates of election to the mayor, deputy mayor, councillors and alternates
etapas.encerramento-do-alistamento: The voter register closes: no voter registration or transfer request is accepted in the 150 days before the election
etapas.impugnacao: Candidates, parties, federations, coalitions and the Public Prosecution Service may challenge registration requests
etapas.julgamento-dos-registros: The electoral judge grants or refuses the registration of municipal candidates
etapas.nomeacao-das-mesas: The electoral judge appoints the members of the polling boards and designates the polling places
etapas.pedido-de-registro: Parties, federations and coalitions ask the electoral judge to register the candidates
etapas.posse: The mayor and deputy mayor take office on 1 January of the following year; councillors as set by the organic law
etapas.prazos-seis-meses: Six months before: parties and federations registered; candidates with residence in the municipality and party membership; resignations
etapas.prestacao-de-contas: Candidates and parties render campaign accounts; the Electoral Justice judges the winners' accounts before certification
etapas.primeiro-turno: Voters in all municipalities vote for mayor and councillor on the same day
etapas.propaganda: Campaign: electoral advertising and free airtime on radio and TV
etapas.segundo-turno: A new vote between the two leading candidates for mayor

proc:eleicao-municipal.resumo: Every four years, two years after the general election, all municipalities elect a mayor, deputy mayor and councillors on the same day. The next one after the reference date is in 2028.

etapas.arquivamento: A rejected or lapsed proposal is shelved; the subject cannot return in the same legislative session
etapas.camara-ccjc: The President of the Chamber sends the proposal to the CCJC, which decides whether it is admissible
etapas.camara-comissao-especial: A special committee, created by the President of the Chamber, examines the merits and gives its report
etapas.camara-plenario: The Plenary votes in two rounds; the proposal needs 3/5 of the deputies (308 votes) in each round
etapas.iniciativa: The proposal is submitted by 1/3 of the deputies or senators, the President, or more than half of the State Legislative Assemblies
etapas.promulgacao: The Steering Boards of the Chamber and the Senate promulgate the amendment, with its serial number, in a session of Congress
etapas.senado-ccj: The Senate CCJ gives its report on the proposal and the amendments
etapas.senado-plenario: The Plenary votes in two rounds; the proposal needs 3/5 of the senators (49 votes) in each round

proc:emenda-constitucional.resumo: Path of a proposed constitutional amendment (PEC): two rounds in each House, 3/5 of the votes and promulgation by the Steering Boards, without assent.

etapas.ativacao: After a message from the President, the operational bodies act on an occasional basis, in a defined area and for a limited time
etapas.controle-operacional: The competent authority transfers operational control of the necessary police forces to the authority in charge of the operation
etapas.decisao: The President decides whether to deploy the Armed Forces and orders the Minister of Defence to activate the operational bodies
etapas.esgotamento: The head of the federal or state Executive recognises that the police forces of art. 144 are unavailable or insufficient
etapas.fim: The deployment ends when the defined time and area run out
etapas.iniciativa: The President acts on his or her own initiative or at the request of a Branch, made by the President of the STF, the Senate or the Chamber

proc:emprego-das-forcas-armadas-na-glo.nome: Use of the Armed Forces to guarantee law and order
proc:emprego-das-forcas-armadas-na-glo.resumo: How the Armed Forces come to act in public order: a request from a Branch or the President's own initiative, recognition that the police are exhausted, and the President's decision.

etapas.escolha: The governor chooses one of the three names
etapas.investidura-automatica: The defender with most votes is automatically vested in the post
etapas.lista-triplice: Members of the career elect the three-name list by direct, secret, multi-name and compulsory vote
etapas.mandato: The Public Defender General serves a two-year term of office, renewable once
etapas.nomeacao: The governor appoints the person chosen

proc:escolha-do-defensor-publico-geral-d.nome: Selection of the state Public Defender General
proc:escolha-do-defensor-publico-geral-d.resumo: The state's defenders elect a three-name list; the governor appoints one of the three within 15 days, or the one with most votes takes office automatically.

etapas.aprovacao: The Senate questions the nominee in a public session and approves or rejects the name
etapas.indicacao: The President of the Republic chooses one of the three and sends the name to the Senate
etapas.lista-triplice: Members of the career elect the three-name list by direct, secret, multi-name and compulsory vote
etapas.mandato: The Federal Public Defender General serves a two-year term of office, renewable once
etapas.nomeacao: The President of the Republic appoints the approved nominee

proc:escolha-do-defensor-publico-geral-f.nome: Selection of the Federal Public Defender General
proc:escolha-do-defensor-publico-geral-f.resumo: Federal defenders elect a three-name list; the President chooses one of the three, the Senate approves by absolute majority and the President appoints.

etapas.lista-triplice: The College of Military Justice Prosecutors elects the three-name list by multi-name, optional and secret vote
etapas.mandato: The Prosecutor General of Military Justice serves a two-year term of office, renewable once by the same procedure
etapas.nomeacao: The Prosecutor General of the Republic appoints one of the three and swears him or her in

proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-da-just.nome: Selection of the Prosecutor General of Military Justice
proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-da-just.resumo: Members of the MPM elect a three-name list, and the Prosecutor General of the Republic appoints one of the three for a two-year term of office.

etapas.escolha: The governor chooses one of the three names
etapas.investidura-automatica: The one with most votes on the list is automatically vested in the post
etapas.lista-triplice: All members of the career elect the three-name list by multi-name vote
etapas.mandato: The Prosecutor General of Justice serves a two-year term of office, renewable once
etapas.nomeacao: The governor appoints the person chosen

proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-de-just.nome: Selection of the state Prosecutor General of Justice
proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-de-just.resumo: Members of the state MP elect a three-name list; the governor appoints one of the three within 15 days, or the one with most votes takes office automatically.

etapas.encaminhamento: The Prosecutor General of the Republic forwards the three-name list to the President of the Republic
etapas.lista-triplice: The College of Prosecutors elects the three-name list by multi-name, optional and secret vote
etapas.mandato: The Prosecutor General of Justice serves a two-year term of office, renewable once after a new list
etapas.nomeacao: The President of the Republic appoints one of the three
etapas.posse: The Prosecutor General of the Republic swears in the appointee

proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-de-just.nome: Selection of the Prosecutor General of Justice of the MPDFT
proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-de-just.resumo: Members of the MPDFT elect a three-name list, the PGR forwards it to the President of the Republic, who appoints one of the three for a two-year term of office.

etapas.lista-triplice: The College of Labour Prosecutors elects the three-name list by multi-name, optional and secret vote
etapas.mandato: The Prosecutor General of Labour serves a two-year term of office, renewable once by the same procedure
etapas.nomeacao: The Prosecutor General of the Republic appoints one of the three and swears him or her in

proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-do-trab.nome: Selection of the Prosecutor General of Labour
proc:escolha-do-procurador-geral-do-trab.resumo: Members of the MPT elect a three-name list, and the Prosecutor General of the Republic appoints one of the three for a two-year term of office.

etapas.congresso-decide: The National Congress approves or rejects the decree
etapas.consulta-conselhos: The President hears the Council of the Republic and the National Defence Council
etapas.decreto: The President decrees the state of defence, with its duration, the areas covered and the coercive measures
etapas.execucao: The measures are carried out, overseen by a committee of Congress
etapas.prorrogacao: The President extends the state of defence once, for up to 30 days
etapas.relatorio-final: Once the measure ends, the President reports to Congress on the steps taken and the persons affected
etapas.submissao-ao-congresso: The President sends the decree and its justification to Congress within 24 hours

proc:estado-de-defesa.resumo: Emergency measure, for up to 30 days extendable once, in restricted and specified places, to deal with serious and imminent institutional instability or a major natural disaster.

etapas.congresso-decide: The National Congress authorises or refuses the state of siege
etapas.consulta-conselhos: The President hears the Council of the Republic and the National Defence Council
etapas.convocacao-extraordinaria: The President of the Senate convenes Congress to meet within 5 days
etapas.decreto: The President decrees the state of siege and then designates the executor and the areas covered
etapas.execucao: The measures are carried out; Congress keeps working and a committee oversees them
etapas.fim-sem-sitio: Without authorisation from Congress, there is no state of siege
etapas.relatorio-final: Once the measure ends, the President reports to Congress on the steps taken and the persons affected
etapas.solicitacao: The President asks Congress for authorisation to decree a state of siege, setting out the reasons

proc:estado-de-sitio.resumo: Emergency measure more serious than the state of defence: it requires prior authorisation from Congress and may suspend constitutional guarantees.

etapas.empenho: The unit commits the expenditure: it reserves the appropriation and creates the obligation to pay
etapas.limitacao-de-empenho: If revenue cannot meet the fiscal targets, each Branch and the Public Prosecution Service limit commitments and payments
etapas.liquidacao: The unit verifies the expenditure: it checks the delivery and the exact amount to be paid
etapas.pagamento: The authority orders payment and the money leaves the treasury
etapas.programacao-financeira: The Executive sets the financial programming and the monthly disbursement schedule
etapas.restos-a-pagar: What was committed and not paid by 31 December is entered as outstanding payables

proc:execucao-da-despesa.resumo: How budget money is spent: financial programming, commitment, verification and payment; what remains unpaid at year-end becomes outstanding payables (restos a pagar).

etapas.acao: The Union brings the expropriation action
etapas.citacao: The judge orders the owners to be summoned, appoints an expert and may put the Union in possession
etapas.incorporacao: Once the judgment is final, the property is incorporated into the Union's assets
etapas.sentenca: The judge holds the hearing and gives judgment

proc:expropriacao-confiscatoria.nome: Expropriation of land with illegal cultivation of psychotropic plants
proc:expropriacao-confiscatoria.resumo: The Union asks the courts to expropriate the land; the judge may immediately put the Union in possession and, at the end, the property passes to the Union without compensation.

etapas.arquivamento: The request is closed by a reasoned decision; it may be renewed
etapas.defesa: The rapporteur in the STF questions the person sought, appoints a defence lawyer if needed and sets a deadline for the defence
etapas.entrega: The Executive authorises the surrender, and the decision is communicated to the requesting State through diplomatic channels
etapas.julgamento: The STF rules on the lawfulness and merits of the request, with no appeal
etapas.negada: Extradition refused; no new request for the same facts is allowed
etapas.pedido: The Executive receives the foreign State's request and checks the formal requirements
etapas.retirada: The requesting State removes the person from the country; if it fails to do so within the deadline, the person is released

proc:extradicao.nome: Extradition requested by a foreign State
proc:extradicao.resumo: The Executive receives the request and checks its form; the STF decides whether the extradition is lawful and well founded; if it is, the Executive authorises the surrender.

etapas.cumprimento: On the set day, the person responsible shows the data to the petitioner or proves in court the correction or annotation
etapas.denegacao: Habeas data is refused; if the decision did not examine the merits, the request may be renewed
etapas.despacho-inicial: The judge dismisses the petition or notifies the person responsible for the data to provide information
etapas.impetracao: If the request to the body is refused or unanswered, the person files the petition with the judge, with proof of the refusal
etapas.indeferimento: The petition is dismissed and the case ends, unless there is an appeal
etapas.ministerio-publico: Once the deadline for information has passed, the Public Prosecution Service is heard
etapas.recurso: The court decides the appeal; if habeas data was granted, the appeal does not suspend the judgment
etapas.sentenca: The judge decides; if the petition is upheld, the judge sets a day and time for the respondent to show the data or prove the correction

proc:habeas-data.resumo: How someone obtains through the courts access to or correction of data about themselves in public records, after the body refuses or fails to reply: petition, information, Public Prosecution Service and judgment within 5 days.

etapas.analise: Conitec checks the request, prepares a technical report and issues a preliminary recommendation
etapas.consulta-publica: The preliminary recommendation goes to public consultation
etapas.decisao: The Ministry of Health decides and publishes the decision in the Official Gazette of the Union
etapas.fim: Technology or protocol adopted, removed or changed in the SUS, or request refused
etapas.recomendacao-final: The Conitec committee deliberates on the final recommendation
etapas.recurso: If the Secretary does not reconsider, the Minister of Health decides the appeal
etapas.requerimento: A request for adoption, removal or change is filed, with documents and studies

proc:incorporacao-de-tecnologia-no-sus.nome: Adoption of technology in the SUS
proc:incorporacao-de-tecnologia-no-sus.resumo: How a medicine, product or procedure enters (or leaves) the SUS: request, analysis by Conitec, public consultation and decision by the Ministry of Health.

etapas.estudos-e-audiencias: The state carries out technical studies and public hearings with all the municipalities of the future unit
etapas.governanca: The state and the municipalities included begin to carry out the region's inter-federative governance
etapas.lei-complementar-estadual: The Assembly passes the complementary law establishing the region, with its municipalities, common functions and governance

proc:instituicao-de-regiao-metropolitana.nome: Establishment of a metropolitan region or urban agglomeration
proc:instituicao-de-regiao-metropolitana.resumo: After technical studies and public hearings, the state establishes the metropolitan region by complementary law, which defines the municipalities, common functions and governance.

etapas.assembleia-aprecia: The State Legislative Assembly approves or rejects the intervention
etapas.cessacao: Once the reasons cease, the removed authorities return to their posts, unless legally barred
etapas.decreto: The governor decrees the intervention, with its scope, duration, conditions and, where applicable, the intervenor
etapas.execucao: The intervention is carried out under the decree, by the intervenor where there is one
etapas.fim-sem-intervencao: If the petition is not upheld, there is no intervention
etapas.hipotese: One of the cases of art. 35 occurs, the only ones that allow the state to intervene in the municipality
etapas.representacao-ao-tj: The Prosecutor General of Justice petitions the State Court of Justice for intervention
etapas.representacao-da-camara: The Municipal Council petitions the governor for intervention
etapas.submissao-a-assembleia: The decree is submitted to the State Legislative Assembly within 24 hours
etapas.tj-julga-representacao: The State Court of Justice rules on the petition and, if it upholds it, requests the governor to intervene

proc:intervencao-estadual.resumo: The state temporarily intervenes in a municipality, only in the four cases of art. 35, by decree of the governor, as a rule submitted to the State Legislative Assembly.

etapas.cessacao: Once the reasons cease, the removed authorities return to their posts, unless legally barred
etapas.congresso-aprecia: The National Congress approves or rejects the intervention
etapas.consulta-conselhos: The Council of the Republic and the National Defence Council may be heard on the intervention
etapas.decreto: The President decrees the intervention, with its scope, duration, conditions and, where applicable, the intervenor
etapas.execucao: The intervention is carried out under the decree, by the intervenor where there is one
etapas.fim-sem-intervencao: If the petition is not upheld, there is no intervention
etapas.hipotese: The President identifies one of the cases of art. 34 that allow intervention in a state or the DF
etapas.representacao-do-pgr: The Prosecutor General of the Republic files a petition for intervention with the STF
etapas.solicitacao-ou-requisicao: The coerced state Branch requests the intervention, or the STF, the STJ or the TSE requires it
etapas.stf-julga-representacao: The STF rules on the Prosecutor General's petition
etapas.submissao-ao-congresso: The decree is submitted to the National Congress within 24 hours

proc:intervencao-federal.resumo: The Union temporarily intervenes in a state or the DF, only in the cases of art. 34, by decree of the President, as a rule submitted to Congress.

etapas.citacao-ou-audiencia: The rapporteur orders the person responsible to be summoned, if there is a debt, or heard at a hearing, if there is not
etapas.condenacao: The TCU orders the person responsible to pay the debt, may impose a fine, and the ruling becomes an enforceable title
etapas.contas-anuais: Internal control audits the annual accounts of the person responsible and issues a report, certificate and opinion
etapas.instrucao: The rapporteur presides over the fact-finding, and the TCU's technical unit examines the accounts
etapas.irregularidade: Are there irregularities in the accounts?
etapas.julgamento: The TCU judges the accounts regular, regular with reservations or irregular
etapas.pagamento-ou-cobranca: The person responsible pays and receives a discharge; if not, the TCU orders the amount to be deducted or collected through the courts
etapas.parecer-do-mp: The Public Prosecution Service at the TCU gives an opinion, mandatory in accounts cases
etapas.pronunciamento-do-ministro: The supervising Minister of State attests to knowing the internal control's findings on the accounts
etapas.quitacao: The TCU discharges the person responsible; for accounts with reservations, it orders the faults to be corrected
etapas.recursos: The person responsible or the Public Prosecution Service at the TCU may appeal the decision
etapas.tce-instauracao: In case of loss to the public purse or accounts not rendered, a special accounts review is opened
etapas.trancamento: The TCU locks the accounts that cannot be settled and closes the case

proc:julgamento-de-contas-pelo-tcu.nome: Judgment of accounts by the TCU
proc:julgamento-de-contas-pelo-tcu.resumo: How the TCU judges the accounts of those who manage federal money: internal control audit, fact-finding, defence, opinion of the Public Prosecution Service, judgment and collection.

etapas.arquivamento: The rejected bill is shelved; in the same legislative session it can return only on a proposal by an absolute majority of a House
etapas.camara-aprecia-emendas-do-senado: The Chamber, as the originating House, accepts or rejects the Senate's amendments
etapas.camara-comissoes: The Chamber's committees give their reports; unlike for an ordinary law, they never decide alone
etapas.camara-plenario: The Plenary votes in two rounds; passage requires an absolute majority of the deputies (257 votes)
etapas.iniciativa: Introduces the complementary bill; those who may propose it are the same as for an ordinary law
etapas.publicacao-e-vigencia: The complementary law is published in the Official Gazette and enters into force on the date it sets or, if silent, after 45 days
etapas.sancao-veto-e-promulgacao: Assent, veto, review of the veto and promulgation follow the same rules as for an ordinary law
etapas.senado-aprecia-emendas-da-camara: The Senate, as the originating House, accepts or rejects the Chamber's amendments
etapas.senado-comissoes: The Senate's committees give their reports; final committee decisions do not apply to complementary laws
etapas.senado-plenario: The Plenary votes in a single round; passage requires an absolute majority of the senators (41 votes)

proc:lei-complementar.nome: Legislative process for a federal complementary law
proc:lei-complementar.resumo: Path of a complementary bill: like an ordinary law, but always voted on in the Plenaries and passed by an absolute majority of each House.

etapas.comissao-mista-parecer: A joint committee gives its report and proposes the resolution setting the content, terms and deadline of the delegation
etapas.congresso-aprecia-projeto: If the resolution so requires, Congress votes on the President's text in a single vote, without amendments
etapas.congresso-delibera-resolucao: Deputies and senators, in a joint session, debate and vote on the draft delegation resolution
etapas.delegacao-insubsistente: If the deadline passes without the President acting, the delegation lapses
etapas.elaboracao: The President drafts the delegated law within the content and deadline set by the resolution
etapas.promulgacao-da-resolucao: The President of the Senate promulgates the delegation resolution and notifies the President of the Republic
etapas.promulgacao-e-publicacao: The President of the Republic promulgates the delegated law, which is published in the Official Gazette of the Union
etapas.rejeicao: Congress rejects the delegation or the text, and there is no delegated law
etapas.solicitacao: The President of the Republic asks Congress for delegated power to legislate on a subject
etapas.vigencia: The delegated law enters into force on the date it sets or, if silent, 45 days after publication

proc:lei-delegada.resumo: The President asks Congress for powers to legislate on a subject; Congress grants them by resolution, and the President issues the law.

etapas.apreciacao-do-veto: The Assembly upholds or overrides the veto
etapas.assembleia-votacao: The Assembly's committees and Plenary examine and vote on the bill; there is no reviewing House
etapas.iniciativa: Introduces the bill in the State Legislative Assembly
etapas.promulgacao-e-publicacao: The governor promulgates and publishes the law; if not, the president of the Assembly promulgates it
etapas.sancao-ou-veto: The governor assents to or vetoes, in whole or in part, the bill passed
etapas.veto-mantido: The veto is upheld and the vetoed part does not become law
etapas.vigencia: The law enters into force on the date it sets; if it sets none, 45 days after publication

proc:lei-estadual.nome: Legislative process for a state law
proc:lei-estadual.resumo: Path of a bill in a typical state: it follows the basic lines of the federal process, but in a single House, the State Legislative Assembly, with the governor's assent or veto.

etapas.apreciacao-do-veto: The Municipal Council upholds or overrides the veto
etapas.camara-votacao: The Municipal Council's committees and Plenary examine and vote on the bill; there is no reviewing House
etapas.iniciativa: Introduces the bill in the Municipal Council
etapas.promulgacao-e-publicacao: The mayor promulgates the law; if the mayor fails to do so within 48 hours, the president of the Council promulgates it
etapas.sancao-ou-veto: The mayor assents to or vetoes, in whole or in part, the bill passed
etapas.veto-mantido: The veto is upheld and the vetoed part does not become law
etapas.vigencia: The law enters into force on the date it sets; if it sets none, 45 days after publication

proc:lei-municipal.nome: Legislative process for a municipal law
proc:lei-municipal.resumo: Path of a bill in a typical municipality: it follows the basic lines of the federal process, in a single House, the Municipal Council, with the mayor's assent or veto.

etapas.apreciacao-do-veto: Deputies and senators, in a joint session, uphold or override the veto; overriding requires an absolute majority in each House
etapas.arquivamento: The rejected bill is shelved; in the same legislative session it can return only on a proposal by an absolute majority of a House
etapas.arquivamento-fim-da-legislatura: At the end of the legislature, a bill still pending in the House is shelved, subject to the exceptions in each set of internal rules
etapas.camara-aprecia-emendas-do-senado: The Chamber, as the originating House, votes on the Senate's amendments, accepting or rejecting them
etapas.camara-comissoes: Subject committees, the CFT (finance) and the CCJC (constitutionality) give their reports and vote on the bill
etapas.camara-distribuicao: Assigns the bill to committees and states whether they decide alone (conclusive review) or the Plenary votes
etapas.camara-plenario: The Plenary debates and votes; it passes by a majority of votes, with an absolute majority of the deputies present
etapas.camara-prazo-de-recurso: Opens a period for one-tenth of the deputies to appeal to the Plenary against the committees' decision
etapas.envio-a-sancao: The House where voting ended sends the bill passed (enrolled bill) to the President of the Republic
etapas.iniciativa-popular: Voters submit a bill to the Chamber signed by 1% of the electorate, from at least 5 states (0.3% in each)
etapas.promulgacao: Promulgates the law, declaring that it exists and must be obeyed
etapas.promulgacao-pelo-presidente-do-senado: Promulgates the law in place of the President of the Republic
etapas.promulgacao-pelo-vice-presidente-do-sena: Promulgates the law when neither the President of the Republic nor the President of the Senate has done so
etapas.publicacao: The law is published in the Official Gazette of the Union
etapas.sancao: Assents to the bill, which thereby becomes law
etapas.sancao-tacita: The President's silence for 15 working days counts as assent
etapas.senado-aprecia-emendas-da-camara: The Senate, as the originating House, votes on the Chamber's amendments, accepting or rejecting them, without sub-amendments
etapas.senado-comissoes: Committees give their reports; in final-decision cases, they approve or reject the bill without going to the Plenary
etapas.senado-distribuicao: Assigns the bill to committees and states whether their decision will be final
etapas.senado-plenario: The Plenary debates and votes; it passes by a majority of votes, with an absolute majority of the senators present
etapas.senado-prazo-de-recurso: Opens a period for one-tenth of the senators to appeal to the Plenary against the final committee decision
etapas.veto: Vetoes the whole bill or entire articles, paragraphs, items or sub-items and informs the Senate of the reasons
etapas.veto-mantido: The veto is upheld and the vetoed part does not become law
etapas.vigencia: The law enters into force on the date it sets; if it sets none, 45 days after publication

proc:lei-ordinaria.nome: Legislative process for a federal ordinary law
proc:lei-ordinaria.resumo: Path of a federal ordinary bill, from introduction to entry into force, through the Chamber, the Senate and the President.

etapas.admissao: The licensing entity checks whether the impact study submitted (EIA/Rima) meets the terms of reference
etapas.audiencia-publica: The licensing entity holds at least one public hearing before deciding on the preliminary licence
etapas.licenca-de-instalacao: The licensing entity grants or refuses the installation licence, based on the basic environmental plan
etapas.licenca-de-operacao: The licensing entity grants the operating licence, after checking the conditions
etapas.licenca-previa: The licensing entity grants or refuses the preliminary licence (environmental feasibility)
etapas.manifestacoes: Authorities involved and other interested entities may give their views, without binding the decision
etapas.negada: Licence refused: the activity cannot be set up or operated
etapas.supletiva: Another entity takes over the licensing on a supplementary basis and restarts the review period
etapas.termo-de-referencia: The licensing entity receives the application and defines the studies required (terms of reference)

proc:licenciamento-ambiental.resumo: A single entity grants the licence: it defines the studies, hears the public and interested parties without being bound by their views, and issues the preliminary, installation and operating licences.

etapas.habilitacao: The company checks the winner's qualification: legal capacity, technical qualifications and financial standing
etapas.homologacao: The contract is awarded and the result ratified; the winner acquires the right to sign the contract
etapas.julgamento: The company evaluates the bids by the criterion in the notice, such as lowest price, highest discount or technique and price
etapas.negociacao: The company negotiates with the first-placed bidder and, if the price is still above budget, with the next ones
etapas.preparacao: The company prepares the tender and publishes the notice in the official gazette and online
etapas.propostas: Bidders submit successive public bids (open auction) or sealed bids (closed auction)
etapas.recursos: Single appeal stage: bidders appeal within 5 working days against the qualification, the evaluation and the check
etapas.revogacao: The tender is revoked in the public interest or because the price is above budget, or annulled for illegality
etapas.verificacao: The company checks the best bids and disqualifies those that are flawed, unworkable or above budget

proc:licitacao-de-empresa-estatal.nome: Public tender by a state-owned company
proc:licitacao-de-empresa-estatal.resumo: The stages of tenders by state-owned and mixed-capital companies under the State-Owned Companies Law: notice, bids, evaluation, negotiation, qualification, single appeal and ratification.

etapas.denegacao: The petition is refused or becomes moot; if refused for lack of evidence, it may be renewed with new evidence
etapas.despacho-inicial: The rapporteur dismisses a petition that is manifestly inadmissible or unfounded, or notifies the respondent to provide information
etapas.exercicio-do-direito: The right is exercised under the conditions set by the court until the rule is issued
etapas.impetracao: The holder of the right files for a writ of injunction against whoever should issue the rule
etapas.indeferimento: The petition is dismissed outright and ends, unless an interlocutory appeal is upheld
etapas.julgamento: The court decides whether there is an omission; if so, it sets a deadline for the rule and the conditions for exercising the right
etapas.ministerio-publico: Once the deadline for information has passed, the Public Prosecution Service gives an opinion
etapas.norma-editada: The rule is issued and governs the exercise of the right
etapas.prazo-para-a-norma: The deadline set by the court for the defaulting authority to issue the rule runs

proc:mandado-de-injuncao.resumo: How someone asks the courts to make up for the lack of a rule that prevents the exercise of a constitutional right: petition, information from the defaulting authority, Public Prosecution Service and a deadline for the rule to be issued.

etapas.decisao-final: The decision becomes final; if it refuses the writ without ruling on the merits, the interested party may go to court by another action
etapas.despacho-inicial: The judge dismisses the petition or notifies the authority, informs the entity's legal defence body and decides on the preliminary injunction
etapas.impetracao: The interested party files the petition with the competent judge, naming the respondent authority
etapas.indeferimento: The petition is dismissed and the case ends, unless there is an appeal or an interlocutory appeal
etapas.ministerio-publico: Once the deadline for information has passed, the Public Prosecution Service gives an opinion
etapas.recurso: The court re-examines the judgment on appeal or, if the writ was granted, automatically
etapas.sentenca: With or without the opinion, the judge grants or refuses the writ
etapas.suspensao-de-seguranca: The president of the court may suspend the injunction or the judgment to avoid serious harm to the public interest

proc:mandado-de-seguranca.resumo: How someone protects in court a clear and certain right against an unlawful act by an authority: petition within 120 days, preliminary injunction, information, opinion of the Public Prosecution Service and judgment within 30 days.

etapas.camara-aprecia-modificacoes: The Chamber votes on the Senate's changes in a single round, without making new changes
etapas.camara-plenario: The Chamber first decides whether there is relevance and urgency and, if so, votes on the merits
etapas.comissao-mista-designacao: The President of Congress creates the joint committee; deputies and senators submit amendments within 6 days
etapas.comissao-mista-parecer: The joint committee votes on a report on constitutionality, urgency and relevance, finances and merits
etapas.conversao-em-lei: The measure converted into law is published in the Official Gazette of the Union
etapas.decreto-legislativo-editado: The President of the Senate promulgates the legislative decree governing the effects of the measure
etapas.decreto-legislativo-efeitos: Congress must regulate, by legislative decree, what happened while the measure was in force
etapas.edicao: Issues the provisional measure, which has the force of law from publication, and sends it immediately to Congress
etapas.envio-a-sancao: The conversion bill goes for assent; assent and veto follow the rules for an ordinary law
etapas.perda-de-eficacia: If voting is not completed in both Houses within 60 + 60 days, the measure loses effect from issue
etapas.promulgacao-sem-alteracao: If approved without changes to the merits, the measure is promulgated by the President of Congress and published as law
etapas.rejeicao: If rejected by one House, the measure loses effect from issue and cannot be reissued in the same legislative session
etapas.relacoes-preservadas: Without a legislative decree within 60 days, acts performed while it was in force remain governed by the measure
etapas.senado-plenario: The Senate also decides on relevance and urgency and then votes on the merits

proc:medida-provisoria.resumo: Path of a provisional measure: it has the force of law from issue, goes through a joint committee, the Chamber and the Senate, and becomes law or loses effect.

etapas.apuracao-e-diplomacao: The counting board or the TRE counts the votes, reviews the previous count and confirms or invalidates certificates of election already issued
etapas.decisao-que-anula: The Electoral Justice annuls votes or polling stations, or strip the winner of a majority race of registration, certificate of election or mandate
etapas.marcacao-da-nova-eleicao: The court schedules the new election, direct or, for governor and mayor, indirect in the last six months of the term
etapas.provocacao-pelo-ministerio-publico: If the TRE does not schedule the new election, the Electoral Public Prosecution Service asks the TSE to schedule it
etapas.renovacao-nas-secoes: The TRE orders repeat voting only in the annulled polling stations; the President of the TRE sets the date
etapas.votacao: Voters vote again before the polling boards

proc:nova-eleicao.resumo: When the Electoral Justice annuls votes that change the result or remove the winner of a majority race from office, voters vote again, in some polling stations or in the whole constituency.

etapas.elaboracao: The Administrative Directorate drafts the proposal, and the President of the CGIBS presents the preliminary proposal to the Higher Council
etapas.execucao: The Higher Council approves the expenditure breakdown, and the CGIBS withholds the approved percentage from each entity
etapas.manifestacao-dos-legislativos: The Legislatures of the entities of the full members approve or reject the proposals; silence counts as approval
etapas.nova-proposta: Upon rejection, the CGIBS executes the last approved budget, adjusted, in monthly twelfths, and publishes a new proposal
etapas.proposta: The Higher Council proposes the percentage of IBS allocated to the CGIBS and the following year's budget, published in the DOU

proc:orcamento-do-cgibs.resumo: The Higher Council proposes by 31 July the IBS percentage and the following year's budget; the Legislatures of the represented entities may reject them within 30 days.

etapas.comunicacao: The court notifies the debtor entity of the precatórios submitted by 1 February, for the following year's budget
etapas.condenacao: The judgment against the public treasury becomes final, and the enforcement court issues the payment requisition
etapas.inscricao: The president of the court checks the precatório and enters it in the debtor entity's chronological order
etapas.orcamento: The debtor entity includes in its budget the funds to pay the precatórios, allocated directly to the Judiciary
etapas.pagamento: The president of the court orders payment by the end of the following financial year, in chronological order and with the priorities
etapas.pago: Was the creditor paid in order and on time?
etapas.pequeno-valor: Is the amount within the small-value limit set by the debtor entity's law?
etapas.rpv: The judge requisitions payment directly from the authority summoned in the case, which pays within 60 days, without a precatório
etapas.sequestro: At the creditor's request, the president of the court authorises seizure of the amount

proc:pagamento-de-precatorio.nome: Payment of a court judgment against the public treasury (precatório)
proc:pagamento-de-precatorio.resumo: How the public authorities pay a final judgment: requisition by the judge, entry by the president of the court, inclusion in the budget and payment in chronological order.

etapas.fim-acesso: The requester receives the information, in full or with the confidential part redacted
etapas.fim-negado: Access is refused at the administrative level
etapas.pedido: The body's SIC receives the request, which need only identify the requester and the information, without stating a reason
etapas.pedido-de-desclassificacao: If declassification is refused within the body, the requester appeals to the Minister concerned
etapas.reclamacao: If there is no reply, the requester complains to the monitoring authority, which decides within 5 days
etapas.recurso-cgu: The CGU decides the appeal within 5 days and, if it upholds it, orders the body to comply with the law within a deadline it sets
etapas.recurso-cmri: The Joint Commission for the Reassessment of Information decides the last administrative appeal
etapas.recurso-no-orgao: The authority above the one that refused decides the appeal within 5 days; in the Executive, a further appeal lies to the highest authority
etapas.resposta: The body grants immediate access or replies within 20 days, extendable by another 10

proc:pedido-de-acesso-a-informacao.nome: Access to information request in the federal Executive
proc:pedido-de-acesso-a-informacao.resumo: How a request under the Access to Information Law is answered and appealed in the federal Executive: reply within 20 days, appeals within the body, to the CGU and to the Joint Commission.

etapas.arquivamento: The petition is dismissed and the member keeps the mandate
etapas.camara-ccjc: The CCJC handles the petition for breach of art. 54 or conviction, or decides the appeal against the Council
etapas.camara-conselho-de-etica: The Chamber's Ethics Council conducts the disciplinary proceedings and votes on the rapporteur's report
etapas.camara-plenario: The Chamber Plenary decides, in an open vote, by absolute majority (257 votes)
etapas.declaracao-pela-mesa: The Steering Board declares the loss in cases of absences, loss of political rights or a decision of the Electoral Justice
etapas.perda-do-mandato: The loss of mandate is formalised, the seat falls vacant and the alternate is called
etapas.representacao: The House's Steering Board or a party represented in Congress files a petition for loss of mandate
etapas.senado-ccj: The Senate CCJ examines the constitutional, legal and juridical aspects of the report recommending loss of mandate
etapas.senado-conselho-de-etica: The Senate's Ethics Council admits the petition, conducts the proceedings and votes on the report
etapas.senado-plenario: The Senate Plenary decides by absolute majority (41 votes)

proc:perda-de-mandato-parlamentar.nome: Loss of mandate of a federal deputy or senator
proc:perda-de-mandato-parlamentar.resumo: How a deputy or senator loses his or her mandate: by vote of an absolute majority of the House, after the Ethics Council, or by declaration of the Steering Board.

etapas.aprovacao-colegiada: The deliberative collegiate body approves the plan before it is sent to the State Legislative Assembly
etapas.audiencias-publicas: Public hearings in the region's municipalities, with documents made public and monitoring by the Public Prosecution Service
etapas.compatibilizacao: Each municipality in the region aligns its master plan with the integrated plan
etapas.elaboracao: Representatives of the state, the region's municipalities and civil society draw up the plan together
etapas.lei-estadual: The plan is approved by state law
etapas.revisao: The plan's law must be revised at least every ten years

proc:plano-de-desenvolvimento-urbano-int.nome: Drawing up the integrated urban development plan
proc:plano-de-desenvolvimento-urbano-int.resumo: The state, municipalities and civil society draw up the metropolitan region's plan, the collegiate body approves it and the State Legislative Assembly turns it into state law.

etapas.ciencia-a-justica-eleitoral: The President of Congress notifies the Electoral Justice of the call; in a plebiscite, bills on the subject are put on hold
etapas.convocacao: The National Congress votes on the legislative decree calling the consultation
etapas.homologacao: The TSE ratifies the result; the proposal is approved or rejected by simple majority
etapas.nao-convocado: Legislative decree rejected: there is no consultation
etapas.organizacao: The Electoral Justice sets the date, publishes the ballot, issues instructions and ensures free airtime on radio and TV
etapas.proposta: At least one-third of the members of the Chamber or the Senate introduce the draft legislative decree calling the consultation
etapas.resultado: Result proclaimed: in a plebiscite, the act may or may not go ahead; in a referendum, the act is ratified or rejected
etapas.votacao: Voters vote, by universal suffrage and direct, secret ballot, approving or rejecting what was submitted

proc:plebiscito-e-referendo.resumo: One-third of one of the Houses proposes, Congress calls it by legislative decree, the Electoral Justice organises the consultation and the TSE ratifies the result, which is decided by simple majority.

etapas.apuracao: The authority that learns of the irregularity must investigate it, through a preliminary inquiry or disciplinary proceedings
etapas.inquerito: The commission investigates, charges the civil servant, receives the written defence and writes the final report
etapas.instauracao: The authority publishes the act forming the commission of three tenured civil servants and may suspend the accused
etapas.julgamento: The authority competent for the penalty decides within 20 days, following the report unless it contradicts the evidence
etapas.pena-anulada: The penalty is annulled and the civil servant's rights are restored
etapas.pena-mantida: The penalty imposed remains in force
