etapas.punicao: The penalty is imposed; do new facts later emerge that justify innocence or show the penalty was inappropriate?
etapas.revisao-comissao: A review commission is formed, which has 60 days to complete its work
etapas.revisao-julgamento: The authority that imposed the penalty decides the review within 20 days
etapas.revisao-pedido: The Minister of State or equivalent authority decides whether to authorise a review
etapas.sindicancia: The preliminary inquiry concludes within 30 days, extendable by 30: it closes the case, imposes a minor penalty or leads to disciplinary proceedings

proc:processo-administrativo-disciplinar.nome: Disciplinary proceedings for federal civil servants
proc:processo-administrativo-disciplinar.resumo: How misconduct by a federal civil servant is investigated and punished: preliminary inquiry or disciplinary proceedings, a commission of three tenured civil servants, defence and judgment by the authority according to the penalty.

etapas.decisao: The competent authority decides, giving reasons, within 30 days, extendable by another 30
etapas.extincao: The procedure is terminated by withdrawal, loss of purpose or failure to provide a document requested from the interested party
etapas.fim: The decision becomes final at the administrative level; a sanction may be reviewed if new facts emerge
etapas.inicio: The procedure starts ex officio or by written request of the interested party to the competent authority
etapas.instrucao: The body conducts the fact-finding: gathers evidence, opinions and reports and may open a public consultation or hearing
etapas.reconsideracao: The appeal, filed within 10 days, goes to the decision-maker, who may reconsider within 5 days
etapas.recurso: The higher authority decides the appeal within 30 days; an appeal goes through at most three levels

proc:processo-administrativo-federal.resumo: General procedure for decisions of the federal administration on requests and specific cases: opening, fact-finding, decision within 30 days and appeal through up to three levels.

etapas.decisao-definitiva: The decision becomes final at the administrative level and is published by the CGIBS
etapas.desistencia: The dispute ends by withdrawal, payment, instalment plan, offsetting or a lawsuit on the same matter
etapas.impugnacao: The taxpayer challenges the assessment within 20 days, with all the evidence; the part the taxpayer acknowledges goes to collection
etapas.julgamento-camara-nacional: The National Integration Chamber decides only the question of law; the decision binds the judges of the Union and the CGIBS
etapas.julgamento-primeira-instancia: The Judgment Chamber of the state of the assessment rules in a virtual session; the chair votes only to break a tie
etapas.julgamento-segunda-instancia: The Appeal Chamber of the same state, with tax officials and taxpayers, rules on the ex officio and voluntary appeals
etapas.julgamento-uniformizacao: The IBS Higher Chamber rules on the harmonisation appeal and settles the national interpretation
etapas.recurso-de-oficio: If the decision goes against the Treasury, the chamber itself appeals ex officio to the second instance
etapas.recurso-de-uniformizacao: The Treasury or the taxpayer appeals within 10 days to the Higher Chamber, showing the conflict with another decision
etapas.recurso-especial: The Treasury or the taxpayer takes the conflict over law common to the IBS and the CBS to the National Chamber, within 10 working days
etapas.recurso-voluntario: The losing taxpayer appeals within 20 days to the Appeal Chamber; the other party may reply within 20 days
etapas.revelia: If no challenge is filed in time, the taxpayer is deemed in default

proc:processo-administrativo-tributario-.resumo: Path of a challenge to an IBS charge at the CGIBS: challenge, judgment by the state's chamber, appeals to the appeal chamber and national harmonisation.

etapas.acao-civil: The PGR brings a civil action in the courts to dismiss a member with life tenure or revoke retirement or availability status
etapas.arquivamento: The inquiry or proceedings are closed
etapas.deliberacao-inquerito: The Higher Council closes the inquiry, requests further inquiries or opens administrative proceedings
etapas.deliberacao-processo: The Higher Council proposes to the prosecutor general that the case be closed or a sanction imposed, or proposes an action for loss of office
etapas.fim: The sanction is imposed or the action proceeds in the courts; a review may be sought at any time
etapas.inquerito: The Inspector General opens a confidential inquiry and appoints a commission of three members to investigate the misconduct
etapas.processo: A commission appointed by the Higher Council conducts the administrative proceedings, with summons, defence and evidence
etapas.sancao: The prosecutor general of the branch imposes a warning, censure or suspension

proc:processo-disciplinar-de-membro-do-m.nome: Disciplinary proceedings against a member of the MPU
proc:processo-disciplinar-de-membro-do-m.resumo: How misconduct by an MPU prosecutor is investigated: inquiry by the Office of the Inspector General, proceedings in the Higher Council, and a sanction by the prosecutor general or an action in the courts.

etapas.cumprimento: The president of the court orders the decision to be carried out immediately; the ruling is drawn up afterwards
etapas.exame-inicial: The rapporteur dismisses the complaint outright in the cases provided for by law or admits it
etapas.improcedencia: The complaint is rejected and the challenged act stands
etapas.indeferimento: The complaint is dismissed at the outset and ends
etapas.informacoes: The rapporteur requests information from whoever performed the act, may suspend it and summons the beneficiary to respond
etapas.julgamento: The court rules on the complaint; if upheld, it quashes the decision or takes the appropriate measure
etapas.ministerio-publico: The Public Prosecution Service reviews the case file, if it did not file the complaint
etapas.proposta: The interested party or the Public Prosecution Service files the complaint, which is assigned to a rapporteur

proc:reclamacao.nome: Complaint (reclamação) to the STF or the STJ
proc:reclamacao.resumo: How a party or the Public Prosecution Service brings to the court a breach of its jurisdiction, its decisions or a binding precedent, and how the court quashes the act.

etapas.alerta: The court of accounts checks the calculation and warns the Branch or body that has exceeded 90% of the limit
etapas.apuracao: At the end of each four-month period, each Branch and body calculates its personnel expenditure and publishes it in the RGF
etapas.reducao: Above the limit, the excess must be eliminated within two four-month periods, one-third in the first
etapas.sancoes: Once the deadline has passed, the Branch or body loses voluntary transfers, guarantees and credit for as long as the excess lasts
etapas.vedacoes: Above 95% of the limit, the Branch or body is barred from granting pay rises, creating posts and hiring

proc:reconducao-da-despesa-com-pessoal-a.nome: Bringing personnel expenditure back within the limit
proc:reconducao-da-despesa-com-pessoal-a.resumo: What happens when a Branch or body spends on personnel close to or above the LRF limit: warning, restrictions, deadline to cut and sanctions.

etapas.decisao-de-primeira-instancia: The electoral judge or electoral board decides
etapas.decisao-final: Final decision; the ruling is enforced immediately, by notice to the judge or court
etapas.julgamento-no-tre: The TRE rules on the appeal, after the opinion of the Regional Electoral Prosecutor
etapas.recurso-ao-stf: The STF rules on the appeal against the TSE's decision
etapas.recurso-ao-tre: The party appeals to the TRE by petition to the judge, who hears the respondent and may revise the decision before forwarding it
etapas.recurso-ao-tse: The TSE rules on the special or ordinary appeal against the TRE's decision

proc:recursos-eleitorais.resumo: Path of an electoral appeal: from the judge or board to the TRE, from the TRE to the TSE in the cases provided for, and, only on constitutional matters or habeas corpus and writs of mandamus, to the STF. General deadline: three days.

etapas.contestacao: The candidate, party or coalition answers the challenge, attaches documents and names witnesses
etapas.edital: The Electoral Justice publishes the request in a public notice, for the information of interested parties
etapas.impugnacao: A candidate, party, coalition or the Public Prosecution Service may challenge the request, in a reasoned petition
etapas.indeferido: Registration refused or cancelled, with no replacement
etapas.instrucao: The judge or rapporteur hears witnesses, carries out inquiries and sets a deadline for final arguments
etapas.julgamento: The electoral judge, the TRE or the TSE grants or refuses the registration and decides the challenge
etapas.pedido: A party, federation or coalition asks the Electoral Justice to register the candidates chosen at the convention
etapas.recurso-ao-tre: The TRE rules on the appeal against the electoral judge's decision, after hearing the Regional Electoral Prosecutor
etapas.recurso-ao-tse: The TSE rules on the appeal concerning the registration, after hearing the Electoral Prosecutor General
etapas.substituicao: The party or coalition may replace a candidate who was barred, withdrew or died

proc:registro-de-candidatura.resumo: The party applies for registration by 15 August; within five days of publication any candidate, party or the Public Prosecution Service may challenge it; the Electoral Justice decides, with appeals up to the TSE.

etapas.analise: The TSE assigns the request to a rapporteur, hears the Office of the Electoral Prosecutor General and orders faults to be corrected
etapas.apoiamento: The party collects signatures from non-member voters, checked by the electoral registry offices, and sets up its bodies
etapas.fundacao: At least 101 founders, with electoral residence in one-third of the states, approve the programme and statute
etapas.julgamento: The TSE registers the party's statute
etapas.pedido-ao-tse: The national leaders ask the TSE to register the statute, with the certificates of support
etapas.registrado: Party registered with the TSE; from then on it informs the Electoral Justice of the composition of its governing bodies
etapas.registro-civil: The Civil Registry of Legal Entities at the party's seat registers the party, which acquires legal personality

proc:registro-de-partido-politico.nome: Creation and registration of a political party
proc:registro-de-partido-politico.resumo: Founders register the party at a registry office, gather voter support in one-third of the states and ask the TSE to register the statute, which gives access to elections and funds.

etapas.fiscalizacao: Congress, with the TCU, oversees the LRF; the TCU warns those approaching the limits or putting the targets at risk
etapas.rgf: The heads of the Branches and bodies publish the four-monthly RGF, with personnel and debt compared with the limits
etapas.rreo: The Executive publishes the two-monthly RREO, with budget execution for all Branches and the Public Prosecution Service

proc:relatorios-fiscais.resumo: Every two months the Executive publishes the RREO, and every four months each Branch and body publishes the RGF; Congress, with the TCU, oversees compliance with the LRF.

etapas.camara-comissoes: The Chamber's committees give their reports; a draft resolution always goes to the Plenary
etapas.camara-plenario: The Chamber Plenary votes; as a rule, it passes by a majority of votes, with an absolute majority present
etapas.congresso-sessao-conjunta: A joint committee gives its report and Congress votes on the draft in a joint session
etapas.iniciativa: A deputy, senator, committee or Steering Board introduces the draft resolution
etapas.promulgacao-pelo-presidente-da-camara: The President of the Chamber promulgates the resolution, without assent
etapas.promulgacao-pelo-presidente-do-senado: The President of the Senate promulgates the resolution of the Senate or of Congress, without assent
etapas.senado-comissoes: The Senate's committees give their reports; in some cases they decide alone (final committee decision)
etapas.senado-plenario: The Senate Plenary votes; as a rule, it passes by a majority of votes, with an absolute majority present

proc:resolucao.resumo: Path of a draft resolution of the Chamber, the Senate or Congress: voted on only by the House (or by Congress in a joint session) and promulgated without assent.

etapas.abertura: In a joint session, Congress opens the legislative session and receives the message of the President of the Republic
etapas.convocacao-extraordinaria: During recess, Congress may be convened in extraordinary session and deliberates only on the matter for which it was convened
etapas.eleicao-das-mesas: Each House elects its Steering Board for two years, in the first and third years of the legislature
etapas.posse-da-legislatura: At the start of the legislature, the elected deputies and senators take office in preparatory sessions of each House
etapas.primeiro-periodo: First period of the ordinary legislative session: the Houses vote on bills, including the LDO
etapas.recesso: Recess: with no ordinary sittings, the Representative Committee acts on behalf of Congress
etapas.segundo-periodo: Second period of the ordinary legislative session: the Houses vote on bills, including the LOA

proc:sessao-legislativa.nome: Legislative session of the National Congress
proc:sessao-legislativa.resumo: The Congress year: two working periods, from 2 February to 17 July and from 1 August to 22 December, with a recess between them; at the start of each legislature, the elected members take office and the Steering Boards are elected.

etapas.deliberacao: The Full Court votes on the proposal; issuing, revising or cancelling the precedent requires two-thirds of the Justices
etapas.edital: The STF publishes a notice on its website and in the Diário da Justiça so that interested parties can make submissions
etapas.exame-formal: The proposal is registered and the President of the STF checks whether it meets the formal requirements
etapas.exame-pelos-ministros: The Justices of the Case Law Committee and then the other Justices give their views electronically
etapas.pauta: The President puts the proposal on the Full Court's agenda or rejects it, if an absolute majority has already come out against it
etapas.pgr: The PGR gives an opinion on the proposal, when not its author
etapas.proposta: The STF, ex officio, or one of the authorised parties proposes issuing, revising or cancelling a statement
etapas.publicacao: The STF publishes the statement in the Diário da Justiça and the DOU; from then on it binds judges and the administration
etapas.rejeicao: The proposal is rejected and the statement is not issued, revised or cancelled

proc:sumula-vinculante.nome: Issuing, revising and cancelling a binding precedent (súmula vinculante)
proc:sumula-vinculante.resumo: How the STF approves, revises or cancels a binding precedent: proposal, public notice, opinion of the PGR, examination by the Justices and a two-thirds vote in the Full Court.

etapas.abertura: Incra opens the procedure, ex officio or at the request of any interested party
etapas.consulta: Incra sends the technical report to Iphan, Ibama, SPU, Funai, the National Defence Council and Palmares
etapas.contestacao: Interested parties may contest the report
etapas.desapropriacao: Incra inspects and values the private property for expropriation, where applicable
etapas.identificacao: Incra identifies and delimits the territory and publishes a notice in the DOU and the state official gazette
etapas.titulacao: Incra issues the collective, undivided title to the community, represented by its association

proc:titulacao-de-territorio-quilombola.resumo: Incra identifies and delimits the territory, publishes a notice, hears other bodies and interested parties, expropriates valid private titles and issues the collective title.
